steps.title: Set up temperature module and plate
steps.instruction: Place the NEST 96‑well 100 µL plate on the 96‑well aluminum adaptor on the temperature module (slot 4) and set the module temperature to 4 °C to keep the reactions cool.

steps.title: Prepare mastermix distribution
steps.instruction: Determine how many columns of mastermix are needed, load the mastermix onto the temperature module, and arrange any tube racks according to the deck state.

substeps.instruction: Calculate required columns: one column serves 24 samples (e.g., 48 samples → 2 columns; 48‑72 samples → 3 columns; continue accordingly).
Load the mastermix onto the temperature module (slot 4) in the calculated number of columns.
If more than one column is used, split the total mastermix volume evenly among the columns.
For any unfilled columns, place mastermix in column 6 of the plate on slot 3.

If tube racks are selected for mastermix: place each tube (holding 24 samples) in slot 3, first row (maximum four tubes in the first row for a 96‑sample run) and distribute the mastermix volume equally among all tubes in that row.

Arrange tube racks according to the deck state: fill tubes by row in one rack before moving to the next, in the order of slots 4, 5, 1, 2. For example, for 27 samples fill the entire first tube rack on slot 4, then the first three tubes in the first row of the tube rack on slot 5.

steps.title: Add samples (if required)
steps.instruction: Transfer each sample into its designated well of the NEST plate; skip this step if samples are already present.

steps.title: Dispense mastermix into wells
steps.instruction: Add the prepared mastermix to each reaction well according to the distribution calculated in step 2.

steps.title: Run PCR
steps.instruction: Close the thermocycler lid, ensure it is sealed, and start the PCR program.
